about.statement: I'm Youssef Mohamed, a graphic designer with *four years of experience* in social media and print design. My designs focus on reaching the viewer clearly and simply, effectively conveying the product's concept while maintaining all aspects of its visual identity. I will help you achieve your goals based on my experience in the field and *my expertise in marketing*.
about.quote: “He sent the campaign on a Thursday night, we posted Friday morning, and the feed finally looked like one brand.”
about.arabic: بصمّم سوشيال ميديا بتبيع فعلاً: فكرة واضحة، تايبوغرافي محترم، وتصميم شغّال على الموبايل قبل أي حاجة.
